message.body:
New assigned task 89: Mail ARC seal preservation domain guard

Execute exactly one verified ChangeSet: cs-mail-arc-seal-preservation-domain-guard-fd001-alignment.

Source/result chain: task86 completed/promoted sending-domain authentication guard at commit a4bacaca36fc0bba549e3600b44f1e1c738bba15 after outbound DKIM/reputation/DLP/tracker guards. Continue P04 mail deliverability/authentication maturity with a pure-domain ARC (Authenticated Received Chain) preservation guard for forwarded mail: forwarded inbound artifacts with prior authentication results must carry current ARC chain evidence before DMARC override/acceptance decisions can preserve authentication context.

Authoritative refs to load before editing: specs/root-hub-pointers.json, docs/AGENTS.md, specs/masterplan.json, specs/master-plan-sequencing.json, .omc/plans/milestones/M07-first-tenant/phases/P04-connect-pro-mail/{phase-spec.md,impl-plan.md}, docs/prds/connect.md SMTP deliverability/AC-01, specs/microservices/mail.json ARC/stable-wave/best-practices entries, existing mail-domain patterns inbound_authentication.rs, sending_domain_authentication.rs, outbound_dkim_signing.rs, outbound_reputation_throttle.rs and lib.rs exports, plus task86 evidence.

Owned scope only: worker-1 mail-domain worktree; crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/arc_seal_preservation.rs; crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs wiring; evidence/fd001/cs-mail-arc-seal-preservation-domain-guard-fd001-alignment-*; evidence/multispectrum/cs-mail-arc-seal-preservation-domain-guard-fd001-alignment.json. Do not touch root manifests/Cargo.lock/contracts/registries/messenger/community/infra/adapters/live DNS/SMTP/crypto or worker-2/worker-3 evidence.

Claim OMX task + Oya VCS before writes. Implement pure-domain deterministic guard only: no DNS/network/crypto/adapters/async. It should return explicit allow/quarantine/reject/review actions, reason constants, audit/ledger event labels, tenant/domain/is-forwarded isolation fields using Classified<DataClass>, staleness/chain-contiguity/instance-count checks, prior auth-result alignment, and redacted non-PII error labels. Tests must be non-empty and cover valid ARC preserved accept, non-forwarded no-ARC allowed, missing chain on forwarded mail, stale chain, broken instance sequence, tenant/domain mismatch, prior auth mismatch, quarantine policy, review policy, and audit label stability. Preserve clean architecture inward dependencies.

Verify fmt, focused arc_seal_preservation tests, full oya-connect-mail-domain tests, nextest for the package, clippy -D warnings, cargo metadata, planning-closure, data-class, architecture-boundaries, catalog validate, dependency-seam with multispectrum evidence, oya git diff --check, Oya VCS verify/done/promote, and commit. Report exact changed files, test counts, evidence paths, promotion status, not-tested gaps, and include a line starting exactly: Subagent skip reason: serialized worker-1 mail-domain ARC seal preservation guard lane; active OMX team already parallelizes worker-2 messenger and worker-3 community work, and this pure domain guard is not safe to split further.
